title: Rhizomelic Chondrodysplasia Punctata Registry
official: Rhizomelic Chondrodysplasia Punctata Registry at Nemours Children's Health
summary: The goal of this registry is to collect medical information on individuals with rhizomelic chondrodysplasia punctata and closely related conditions. The study team hopes to learn more about these conditions and improve the care of people with it by establishing this registry.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosed with RCDP or closely related conditions by metabolic and/or genetic testing

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not meeting diagnosis of RCDP or closely related conditions by study team physician review of prior metabolic and/or genetic testing
